title: Burton Senior Center
subtitle: Who it serves and what it offers -- calendar year 2025

summary.heading: What this means for you
body: The Burton Senior Center is one of the busiest in the region. In 2025 it served 1,564 members with about 28,710 visits -- an average of 116 people every day it was open. Nearly three-quarters of members (72%) come from outside the city, so Burton's center is a hub for older adults across the surrounding area.

It is far more than a place to gather: the center ran nutrition, health-and-fitness, social-service, and outreach programs totaling more than 131,052 hours in 2025, and provided about 1,499 rides for grocery trips, appointments, and getting to and from the center. Just over half of members (52%) live alone, so for many it is a primary source of meals, activity, and connection.
Much of this runs on volunteers: 51 people gave about 4,615 hours in 2025 -- roughly $69,046 of donated time -- staffing bingo, the kitchen, tax help, and the reception desk.

source: City of Burton Senior Center activity records (member check-in and program system), calendar year 2025.
notes: "Visits" and "program sign-ins" count every attendance (one person is counted each time they come); "members" and "volunteers" count each person once. Members may live outside the city -- the center serves older adults across the surrounding area, not Burton residents only.
Volunteer value is the center's pay-equivalent estimate of donated hours, not money spent. Monthly figures are the average attendance per open day; the center was open 248 days in 2025.
Source: City of Burton Senior Center, 2025 activity records. Aggregate counts only -- no personal information.
